description:
## Problem

None of the `app.session.*` actions can fire because the session selector component does not exist in octo_pi. Upstream defines 10 session actions; 4 (`new`, `tree`, `fork`, `resume`) have empty default keys and are reached only via slash commands or user bindings; 6 (`togglePath`, `toggleSort`, `toggleNamedFilter`, `rename`, `delete`, `deleteNoninvasive`) only fire inside the session-selector modal.

## Upstream component

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/session-selector.ts`. Handler at lines 526-626. Activated via:
- `/resume` slash command (`interactive-mode.ts:2519`)
- `app.session.resume` action (default keys empty)
- Both call `showSessionSelector()` (`interactive-mode.ts:4225-4258`)
- Constructor takes a `SessionsLoader` callback (lazy load with progress); `SessionManager.list(cwd, sessionDir, onProgress)` and `SessionManager.listAll`.

## Bindings consumed

| Action | Default | Effect (`session-selector.ts:line`) |
|---|---|---|
| `tui.input.tab` | tab | `:540-544` Toggle scope (cwd-only ↔ all sessions) |
| `app.session.toggleSort` | `ctrl+s` | `:547-549` Cycle sort mode |
| `app.session.toggleNamedFilter` | `ctrl+n` | `:552-555` Toggle named-only filter |
| `app.session.togglePath` | `ctrl+p` | `:558-562` Toggle full-path display |
| `app.session.delete` | `ctrl+d` | `:565-568` Open delete confirmation |
| `app.session.rename` | `ctrl+r` | `:571-577` Open inline rename input |
| `app.session.deleteNoninvasive` | `ctrl+backspace` | `:581-590` Same as delete only if search empty; else forwards to search input |
| `tui.select.up/down/pageUp/pageDown/confirm/cancel` | arrows/enter/esc | `:593-619` Standard nav |
| (anything else) | — | `:622-625` Forward to search input |

## Slash commands to wire

| Command | Upstream line | Action | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/new` | `interactive-mode.ts:2488` | `app.session.new` | `handleClearCommand()` (`interactive-mode.ts:5156-`) |
| `/tree` | `:2473` | `app.session.tree` | `showTreeSelector()` — see tree-selector ticket |
| `/fork` | `:2463` | `app.session.fork` | `showUserMessageSelector()` (`:4033-`). **Depends on a separate user-message-selector component; defer or stub for first iteration.** |
| `/resume` | `:2519` | `app.session.resume` | `showSessionSelector()` (`:4225-`) |

## Delete behavior

Tries `trash` CLI first; falls back to `unlink`. See `session-selector.ts:629-` (function `deleteSessionFile`). Special handling for paths starting with `-` (uses `--` separator). Trash error hint is shown via stderr first line.

## Rename behavior

Calls `SessionManager.open(sessionFilePath).appendSessionInfo(nextName)` (`interactive-mode.ts:4244-4249`). Inline rename input replaces the search input on the selected row.

## Required defaults to add to `OctoPi.TUI.Keybindings`

```elixir
"app.session.new" => %{keys: [], description: "Start a new session"},
"app.session.tree" => %{keys: [], description: "Open session tree"},
"app.session.fork" => %{keys: [], description: "Fork current session"},
"app.session.resume" => %{keys: [], description: "Resume a session"},
"app.session.togglePath" => %{keys: ["ctrl+p"], description: "Toggle session path display"},
"app.session.toggleSort" => %{keys: ["ctrl+s"], description: "Toggle session sort mode"},
"app.session.toggleNamedFilter" => %{keys: ["ctrl+n"], description: "Toggle named session filter"},
"app.session.rename" => %{keys: ["ctrl+r"], description: "Rename session"},
"app.session.delete" => %{keys: ["ctrl+d"], description: "Delete session"},
"app.session.deleteNoninvasive" => %{keys: ["ctrl+backspace"], description: "Delete session when query is empty"},
```

## Files likely created/modified

- Existing: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/session_selector.ex` — review and extend. (A search showed this file already exists.)
- New helper: single-line `Input` component if not present — note that upstream's `Input` reuses many `tui.editor.*` actions for cursor/deletion/yank with its own per-instance `KillRing`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` slash command dispatch.

## Suggested subticket carving

1. Selector skeleton: load + nav + select + cancel.
2. Search input + scope toggle (`tab`).
3. Sort / path / named-filter toggles.
4. Rename inline-input flow.
5. Delete confirmation + trash/unlink fallback.
6. `deleteNoninvasive` nuance (empty-query gate).
7. Slash commands `/resume`, `/new`, `/reload` (defer `/tree` to tree-selector ticket; defer `/fork` to user-message-selector future ticket).

## Cross-ticket dependency notes

- `/tree` overlaps with the tree selector ticket — defer that command's wiring to whichever lands second.
- `/fork` needs a user-message-selector component (`interactive-mode.ts:4033-`) — stub or defer.
- `/new` calls `handleClearCommand` which already exists in `interactive.ex` — verify before reimplementing.
title: Session selector component + slash commands (/new, /tree, /fork, /resume, /reload integration)
